name: walkthrough-app
description: Turns an auctioneer's own listing photos into a polished walkthrough video. Standalone app, independent of the sibling ADI product-search app in this repo.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix server" --names "client,server" --prefix-colors "cyan,yellow"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.test:server: npm run build --prefix server && npm run test --prefix server
